title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blueberry B Gum Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry B' Gum mixes juicy Blueberry sweetness with a classic Bubblegum-style note. It delivers a fruity, confectionery flavour that’s smooth, sweet and instantly recognisable. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod pack includes a prefilled 2ml pod attached to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No bottles, no mess and no separate coil changes. Just connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The pod features a dual mesh coil and draw-activated inhale for consistent taste and discreet MTL vapour. A single pod can provide up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on personal habits. Replace with a fresh pod once flavour softens or the reservoir is empty. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
